openings.claim: Delays may reflect cabinet navigation, idle equipment elsewhere, or simultaneous unavailability.
openings.discriminator: Idle items at cabinets versus elsewhere versus all in use.
openings.fit: Preserves constraints if observation fits steward duties.
openings.probe: Tally duration, search location, heading confusion and visible availability without redirecting participants; mark unchecked rooms unknown.
openings.uncertainty: Stock presence does not establish availability; coverage may be limited.

openings.claim: Table signs could expose available equipment outside cabinets.
openings.discriminator: Faster outside-cabinet requests with accurate signs; stale signs or cabinet-dominated delays weaken mechanism.
openings.fit: Requires unobstructed tables, low update effort and uninterrupted collection.
openings.probe: Separate search locations; pilot full-type-name available/in-use counts updated on transfers, optionally duplicating unreadable asset labels. Across four sessions compare durations, sign accuracy and sign-plus-cabinet totals against physical counts.
openings.uncertainty: Updates and aggregate totals may be unreliable.

openings.claim: Discrepancies may reflect enumeration, coverage, concurrent movement or overnight transfers.
openings.discriminator: Immediate disagreement implicates enumeration/concurrent movement; later disagreement following immediate agreement supports interval/coverage effects.
openings.fit: Uncertain until uninterrupted verification is feasible.
openings.probe: For four closings compare routine totals with immediate numbered checks across both rooms, tables and cabinets; repeat coverage next morning. Record locations, concurrent moves, anonymous numbered later-transfer slips, signed differences and verification time.
openings.uncertainty: Untracked transfers or delayed checks leave attribution unresolved.

decision: Diagnose before selecting signs. Preserve permanent IDs, anonymous borrowing, four-cabinet storage and scheduled workshops; share the 60-unit/120-minute preparation cap. Causality remains unestablished. Assess four-session fulfillment >=90% within two minutes and closing error <=1 against contemporaneous physical checks.
